Bug_Details:
This annotation is missing required modifiers as specified by its @RequiredModifiers annotation This annotation is itself annotated with @RequiredModifiers and can only be used
when the specified modifiers are present. You are attempting to use it on an
element that is missing one or more required modifiers.
Bug_Explanation: The Comparable interface is marked with the RequiredModifiers annotation, which specifies that the sort method in the Arrays class must only be used with elements that implement the Comparable interface. However, in this code, the sort method is used with an array of strings, which do not implement the Comparable interface. This causes a compile-time error because the array elements do not have the required modifiers.
